answer: Make every newcomer earn a marble pass before it can cross the economy's bridge: it must complete a voyage of useful work through three unrelated domains, each leg checked by a different veteran who stamps the pass, so no fake identity crosses on borrowed history. The pass binds to one key and cannot be copied, bought, or sold. Random pilot audits re-check a sample of passes each epoch, freezing any whose stamps repeat signers or tasks. Sybil farms must fund a pass, sail every leg, and survive audits for every clone, costing more than honest work pays.
